kernel_check.boundary: Sum of explicit env.addDeclCore(doCheck=true) calls for original theorem types/proof terms under fresh names, using imported dependencies. Includes private/generated emitted theorem constants; excludes definitions, inductives, import/scan overhead and independent transitive dependency replay. Zero after means no selected-module theorem work remains, not zero surviving-library cost.

affected_root_check.boundary: Trust-zero root import/elaboration wall time, separately from explicit kernel proof replay.

theorem_preservation.emission_boundary: Shared/generated logical constants can survive under other retained emission owners; native emission counts are not source declaration origins.
